name: Threat indicator observed
purpose: Match telemetry against the local indicator registry with clear provenance.
description: Compares event domains and addresses with active local indicators. Allowlisted indicators are skipped. A match is context, not proof of compromise.

attack.justification: Not asserted: an indicator match shows contact with a listed value, not an adversary technique.

playbook.what: Telemetry contacted {indicator}, which is in the local indicator registry.
playbook.why: The indicator is listed as suspicious by its source. Contact suggests that the host interacted with something previously reported.
playbook.howSure: Low. Indicators go stale, get reused and can be wrong. Check the indicator's source, confidence and age on the Threat Intel page.
next: Open the indicator and read its source and freshness.
Find which process or user made the request.
verify: The contact is explained, or the host is investigated and the contact stops.
alternatives: Shared infrastructure used by legitimate services.
